page.layout: One printed page: title page, centred. Title lines at top, a woodcut engraving in the middle, imprint lines below it. No running head, page number or signature.
page.notes: Woodcut engraving between the title and the imprint, showing a Hebrew tetragrammaton (יהוה) in a cloud above two figures beside a tree and a stream of water. Hebrew letters are reproduced as printed. A small handwritten mark below the imprint is not transcribed.
